body.p: He got the mullet from the river, took it up to Kangargraon; he met the women coming from Kangargraon with poorawang [samia nuts, or native arrowroot]; they fetched the poorawang, they talked to that dog; they said "where have you come from?" "I am bringing mullet from the river." That will do. The women corrobory gesticulating with the left hand; they fall dead. This was at Bendthualaly.
